## Pull Request Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes made in this pull request.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
Describe how you tested your changes:
- [ ] Backend Pytest suites pass (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] Ruff formatting & linting pass (`uv run ruff check .`)
- [ ] Frontend build passes (`npm run build`)
- [ ] `./scripts/lint.sh` succeeds without errors

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project architecture & formatting standards
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] No TODO comments or unhandled placeholders added
